evaluation_label: OUR LOCAL MSD TASK01 VALIDATION EVALUATION — NOT REPRODUCED PAPER RESULTS
limitation: Cross-dataset demonstration; training/test patient overlap with BraTS 2021 is not verified. Not an independent benchmark or paper reproduction.

split.method: existing manifest order and configured train_ratio

metric_policy.dice: Per-case per-region Dice; empty ground-truth regions are undefined/excluded, matching MONAI ignore_empty=True. Nonempty GT and empty prediction scores zero.
metric_policy.hd95: MONAI symmetric Euclidean HD95: maximum of the two directed 95th-percentile surface distances, using physical voxel spacing in mm.
metric_policy.empty_hd95: Both masks empty: undefined/excluded. Exactly one empty: Infinity retained in primary mean. Finite-only means are separate and exclude these failures.

nifti_space: Preprocessed RAS orientation and 1 mm spacing; region volume last axis is TC, WT, ET

summary.overall_definition: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of TC, WT and ET case-mean metrics; not pooled voxel Dice.
